10. Kona Village Inn - historic inn in Kailua-Kona, starting at $120 per night.  
11. Kona Seaside Hotel - beachfront hotel, starting at $150 per night.  
12. Hale Kai O'Kailua - beachfront condo complex, starting at $180 per night.
